name: Zabbix API Patterns
description: Zabbix MCP fundamentals through Conduit: the X-Zabbix-Base-Url and X-Zabbix-Api-Token headers, version-dependent token auth, the read-only 18-tool surface (one admin-gated tool, three opt-in tools Conduit does not list), the shared JSON-RPC get parameters (output, filter, search, tags, sortfield, limit), keyset paging by event ID or time range, the 500-row cap, output truncation and redaction, and the error types the sidecar returns.
